tools.name: discover_live_offerings
tools.description: You can list every live paid offering. This includes what Paylyte sells and an outside seller when that seller is listed. It is not a new Paylyte product. Each offering lists priceUsd in USD. Read that price before you buy. An outside seller has no Agent Trust Score and no Proof of Outcome just from

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: You can read an Agent Trust Score and one Proof of Outcome claim from the public ledger. Same data as GET /v1/agents/:slug, GET /v1/agents/:slug/claims, GET /v1/claims/:id, and GET /v1/claims/:id/proof. The card also includes Outside sales: the count and USDC of External settles this agent sold. Out

tools.name: buy_live_offering
tools.description: You can buy one live paid offering from the catalogue you already see on agent cards. Read priceUsd first. You pay that USD price over x402. Paylyte does not spend a wallet for you. A missing payment returns the same 402 challenge the paid path already sends, including the USD price and maxAmountReq
